punctuation._note: 密集标点训练：逗号/分号/冒号/引号/括号/破折号/问号/感叹号，标点密度 >= 15%
sentences: The meeting — rescheduled twice — finally started at 3:15 p.m.; everyone, exhausted, agreed: "Never again!"
She asked, half-joking: "Did you really type 120 wpm (words per minute) in 60 seconds?" He nodded: "Twice."
Groceries: eggs, milk, bread, two apples; optional: dark chocolate, peanut butter, coffee (decaf), honey.

The itinerary: Day 1 — arrive, check in, dinner (casual); Day 2 — meetings 9-5; Day 3 — free! (or so we hoped)

The manual states: "Press CTRL+ALT+DEL (all three at once), wait 10 seconds, then press ENTER. Do not panic."
Rain, sleet, snow, or shine — the mail must go out; or so the creed says. Today: sleet. Tomorrow: who knows?
The quiz had one question: "Which sentence is punctuated correctly?" All four options looked identical!
He wrote in his journal: "Dear Diary — today I beat my record (78 wpm), but accuracy dropped to 89%."

Her favorite quote: "Semicolons are just commas that went to grad school" — attributed to nobody in particular.

We debated: tabs or spaces? Python says spaces (4, exactly); Makefiles say tabs; the office said "whatever."
The text message read: "OMG!!! U won't BELIEVE this -- check ur email NOW!! (sent from my phone, sorry :P)"
Final checklist: tickets? Passport? Charger (both!)? Adapter? Print the confirmation — twice. Lock the door.
Wait... what? No! Yes — maybe? Hmm; oh well! Whatever...
Stop! Go? Wait — no, not yet... now! (Okay, now.)
Really?! Seriously?? Who, me? When? Where? Why?! How?!
One, two, three — go! (Ready? Set? GO!!!)
It's done; it's done! It's FINALLY done... (phew).
Huh? What was that? Say again? Louder? Slower? Please?!
Oops — sorry! My bad; won't happen again (promise).
Yes, yes, yes — no, no, no! Wait... maybe yes?
3, 2, 1... blastoff! (Or was it 5, 4, 3? Whoops.)
Done? Not yet. Almost? Kind of. Soon? Hopefully!
Ha! Ha ha! HA HA HA!!! (That's genuinely funny.)
Ugh... why? Why me? Why now? Why like THIS?!
Hmm... let me think. Ah — got it! (Maybe.)
Left? Right? Straight? Back? Up? Down? Which way?!
Oh! Oh!! OH!!! I see it now — finally, I get it.
No way! Yes way! No WAY!!! (Are you serious?)
Wait, wait, wait — hold on... okay, continue.
First: breathe. Second: type. Third: don't panic!
A-B-C, 1-2-3 — easy as that (or so they say).
What?! When?! How?! Who told you this? ME? Never!
So... anyway. Where was I? Oh — right! Here we go.
Maybe, possibly, perhaps? Or definitely, certainly?!
Tick-tock, tick-tock... time's up! (Sorry, no more.)
Boom! Crash! Bang! Wallop! — comics, basically.
Hi. Bye. Hi again? Bye again... okay, see ya!
This, that, the other — you know, stuff (and things).
Why, though? I mean... really, why? Explain? Please?
Up, down, left, right, B, A, start! (Konami, classic.)
Well — I never! Honestly? Shocked. Shocked, I say!
Okay: 1) read, 2) type, 3) repeat. Simple? Simple.
So? Well? And?! Then?! What now? Who cares... (I do!)
No — no, no, no! Yes? Maybe?! Ugh... fine, okay!

Wait — stop! Hold on... okay, go. No wait, STOP!
Aah, eek, oof, wow — sounds, basically (typed out).
This (that) [those] {them} — brackets, all four kinds!

What if... never mind. Forget it. Actually — wait!
Hmm, well, so, uh — you know? (Fillers, punctuated.)
Why, why, WHY?! Enough! Stop!! (Please? Okay, fine.)
Up? Down? In, out — over, under; through?! Around!
Ha. Ha ha. HA!!! (Funny, right? Right... right?)
Now! Not later — NOW. Later's too late; now's fine.
quotes: "The difference between the right word and the almost right word," Mark Twain wrote, "is the difference between lightning and a lightning bug."
Churchill reportedly said: "Ending a sentence with a preposition is something up with which I will not put!" — though historians doubt it (rightly?).
"In theory," Yogi Berra quipped, "there is no difference between theory and practice; in practice, there is." Nobody has improved on it since.
Oscar Wilde: "I can resist everything except temptation." Short, sharp, devastating — and impossible to punctuate better.

game._note: 真实游戏：combo 连击倍率 + 分数 + 等级递增 + 错误清零 combo + 视觉反馈
game.css: .game-hud{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:0 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hud-cell{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:8px 16px;text-align:center;min-width:74px}.hud-lab{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.hud-cell b{font-size:22px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono)}.game-hud.shake{animation:hshake .3s}@keyframes hshake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-6px)}75%{transform:translateX(6px)}}.lvl-fx{position:absolute;left:50%;top:40%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:34px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--accent);pointer-events:none;animation:lvlup 1.2s ease-out forwards;z-index:5}@keyframes lvlup{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.5)}20%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.15)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-90%) scale(1)}}.variant-res{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.vr-title{font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px}.vr-grid{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}.vr-grid>div{text-align:center}.vr-grid b{display:block;font-size:26px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono)}.vr-grid span{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim)}.spark{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);pointer-events:none;z-index:4;animation:spark .5s ease-out forwards}@keyframes spark{0%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(.3)}}.vr-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--soft);text-align:center}
